aliases: AXIS Q6045-E Mk II PTZ Dome Network Camera

power.method: High PoE via included Axis High PoE 60 W Midspan 1-port (midspan 100-240 V AC, max 74 W)

features: Outdoor-ready, IP66/NEMA 4X/IK10 aluminum casing with sunshield
Arctic Temperature Control: start-up as low as -40 C
32x optical zoom, 12x digital zoom (384x total), autofocus
Pan 360 endless, tilt 220, up to 450 per second
256 preset positions, tour recording, guard tour, E-flip
1080p up to 30 fps, 720p up to 60 fps
WDR up to 120 dB, highlight compensation, automatic defog
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_q6045e_mkii_1485649_en_1512.pdf). Operating range -50 to 50 C is with the 60 W midspan (-20 to 50 C with 30 W midspan); 74 W is the midspan maximum, camera draw not stated. Auto-matched sheet was the indoor Q6045 Mk II datasheet; replaced.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path; not yet verified on this model.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.
